releaseNotes: A direct desktop sidebar gives Today, Assignments, School updates, Timetable, Resources, Topics covered, Attendance and Student marks their own destinations.
Narrow windows use one menu with the same labels and order. Each choice opens the same page every time, while views retain their filters and reading position.
The Today overview, combined inbox, private Reviewed controls and non-blocking updates are unchanged. Settings and Update details are at the bottom of the navigation.
Existing credentials, schedules, saved resources, student history and private assignment status are preserved. School access remains read-only.
